tips.text: Drag the map or use WASD to look around, and scroll to zoom. Your goals are in the list at the top left.
News turns up on the right. Click it to jump to where it happened, or × to put it away.
Pick a building, then click a highlighted spot on the map to place it. Building takes a few days.
Hire people here, then send each one to a zone. Wages come out every day.
Every animal in the reserve. Show finds them on the map; Read opens my notes on them.
Sound, text size, colour-blind mode and your saves are all in here.
We're spending more than we have. Staff who aren't paid for three days leave. Cut costs or wait for money to come in.
The gate first. Click the broken fence across the road by the gate to mend it.
Click Waterhole A to pour in water. Hold the button down to keep pumping.
Keep the water up and give the animals a day or two. The 2× and 4× buttons at the top right speed time up.
Look for the little markers around the reserve and click them to see what happened to the old pump.
Open Build and put a borehole pump on the old pump site above Waterhole A.
Open Staff and hire a ranger. They'll keep an eye on the animals.
Earn more than you spend for five days. Hover the money at the top to see where it goes.
